preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have some ETH balance from accumulated taxes

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setWallets() to change the marketing and development wallet addresses to attacker-controlled addresses. Then trigger a sell transaction to accumulate taxes in the contract, which will be automatically swapped to ETH and distributed to the attacker-controlled wallets via contractSwap(). Alternatively, use sweepContingency() before liquidity is added to drain any ETH in the contract.
